name: @tabaca/backend
description: Django API and admin for Tabaca (Python, managed with uv)

scripts.dev: uv run python manage.py migrate --verbosity 0 && uv run python manage.py runserver
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
